expected_findings.rationale: A bare number with no unit of measure is not a valid net quantity declaration. A system that reports FAIL has correctly identified the defect; NEEDS_REVIEW is an acceptable cautious alternative, but a confident PASS is a real miss.
Rolled oats is a cereal containing gluten, a regulated allergen under FSSAI 5(14)(i), and a separate Contains statement naming it is present on the label.

trap: A system that just checks whether a number is present near the front of the pack, without checking for an actual unit, will confidently PASS this when it should not.
notes: The dedicated ambiguous-fact case: extraction may reasonably report the field as present, and the real test is whether compliance judgment recognises that presence without a unit does not satisfy the requirement. Expected overall is NEEDS_REVIEW, not FAIL, for the same reason as IN-001 and UK-001: RULE-IN-FOOD-007 accepts NEEDS_REVIEW as well as FAIL, and a system that lands on the accepted NEEDS_REVIEW path correctly produces an overall NEEDS_REVIEW under the report logic in backend/app/services/report.py, since no other rule fails on this case.
